scope: Bindings v5: classic OOXML PPTX chart frame resizing, without rebuilding chart or workbook parts

implementation.proof: Unique internal classic chart relationship from the native frame, chart content type and bounded chartSpace/chart/plotArea XML
implementation.mutation: Only graphicFrame/xfrm; existing inverse parent-frame and one-slide-EMU geometry checks apply
implementation.opaque_preservation: Chart XML, embedded XLSX, relationships, styles, caches, axes, 3D and manual layout data remain exact original payloads
implementation.compatibility: v1-v4 retain previous scopes; v4 table resize explicitly regression-tested; no automatic chart resize in old snapshots
implementation.scope_guard: Data/title/rotation changes are unbound and refuse atomically; chartEx or external chart-part links do not get resize permission
implementation.limits: Selected byte/node/depth budgets cover chart XML; cancellation checked after proof and before geometry mutation
implementation.shared_dom: Shape text, table text/grid and chart frame edits can coexist in one slide DOM

checks.regression_command: python -m pytest tests/readers tests/writers tests/support/test_ooxml_pptx_package.py tests/support/test_ooxml_package.py -k 'pptx or office_export_cancellation or ooxml_package' -q --tb=short
checks.release_archives: 0.42.0 wheel/sdist licenses, resources, metadata and required modules verified

minimal_pptx_profile.scope: Installed wheel; two JSON cycles; shape text/frame, merged table text/grid and chart frame edits share one slide; all other payloads unchanged
minimal_pptx_profile.inventory_scope: Reviewed uv.lock unchanged; minimal smoke additionally resolves xlsxwriter 3.3.1, lock pins 3.3.0

native_acceptance.process_ownership: Fresh app only, macros disabled, read-only source, owned decks closed, owned RCWs released and process exit awaited

limits: Finite acceptance on own classic chart profiles, not all chart layouts
No chart data, title, cached series or embedded workbook edits
No rotation, chartEx, external chart-part references or group-frame normalization
Native/opaque data retained; no full semantic chart model claim
ZIP storage metadata, archive byte identity and arbitrary signature edits remain unsupported
